title: ReminderOutput
description: Schema-validated output of the NL Reminder Agent CLI. Version v1. Any change to field names, types, or enum values requires a schema version bump and a new $id.

intent.description: The agent's interpretation of the user's request.

title.description: The task title extracted or inferred from the request. Non-null and non-empty for intent=create. Best-effort for reschedule/snooze. Null for clarify and refuse.

due.description: ISO-8601 datetime string with explicit UTC offset (e.g. 2026-11-16T15:00:00+05:30). Non-null for create/reschedule/snooze when time is determinable. Null for clarify and refuse.

priority.description: Task priority inferred from the request. Defaults to medium when no signal is present.

tags.description: Array of topically relevant short strings. May be empty.

clarification_question.description: A focused question asking for the specifically-missing information. Non-null and non-empty when intent=clarify. Null otherwise.

refusal_reason.description: An explanation of why the request was refused. Non-null and non-empty when intent=refuse. Null otherwise.
